metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Trust Boundary Audit Checklist
metadata.description: High-fidelity audit checklist for trust boundary edge properties. These represent the most critical security properties where data flows between actors of different trust levels.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP: Validate wrap amount bounds and underlying token transfer
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the LiquidityManager contract's wrap() function
2. Verify that the amount parameter is validated against the BN254 field constraint (<=2^248-1)
3. Check that transferFrom is called BEFORE any state changes or minting
4. Verify the IncentiveLib.computeReward() is called with correct parameters
5. Confirm the minted amount equals (wrap amount + calculated reward)
6. Check for reentrancy guards or CEI pattern usage
7. Verify Wrapped event is emitted with correct parameters

executable_checks.assertion: No reentrancy vulnerabilities detected in wrap() function
Wrap with value > 2^248-1 must revert with ValueTooLarge error
Wrap without sufficient underlying balance must revert

executable_checks.command: Review wrap() function for checks-effects-interactions pattern
executable_checks.assertion: transferFrom must be called before mint

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-077-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP, which is essential for PROP-077-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP to hold true in the code. The untrusted user submits a wrap request to the trusted LiquidityManager contract.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP correctly enforces amount validation to protect the boundary
detection_procedure: 1. Trace the entry point of wrap() function
2. Verify all function parameters are validated before any state changes
3. Check that the function properly handles edge cases (zero amount, max amount)
4. Verify that the function reverts appropriately on invalid inputs

executable_checks.assertion: Wrap with zero amount must handle correctly (revert or no-op)
Invariant: totalWrapped <= underlying.balanceOf(address(this))

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-077-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP -> Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP. This check verifies the state validation at the boundary entry point.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY correctly enforces liquidity pull before minting to protect the boundary
detection_procedure: 1. Verify transferFrom is called before mint in the execution flow
2. Check that transferFrom success is required (not silently ignored)
3. Verify the pulled amount matches the wrap amount exactly
4. Check for potential flash loan attacks during this operation

executable_checks.assertion: No unchecked ERC20 transfers in wrap() function
Wrap must revert if transferFrom fails

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-077-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP -> Action ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY. This check verifies the critical ordering: liquidity pull must precede minting.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20: Validate correct recipient and amount for minting
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the mint call in wrap() function
2. Verify the recipient is msg.sender (the original caller)
3. Verify the minted amount is exactly (wrap amount + reward)
4. Check that no other recipient can be specified
5. Verify the hash chain is updated correctly after minting

executable_checks.assertion: Minted tokens must go to msg.sender
Minted amount must equal wrap amount + calculated reward
Recipient parameter must be msg.sender, not user-controllable

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-082-EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20 -> Edge EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary where trusted LiquidityManager mints tokens to untrusted user.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP: Validate unwrap amount and balance checks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the LiquidityManager contract's unwrap() function
2. Verify that user's zERC20 balance is checked before burning
3. Check that fee calculation uses ceiling rounding (ceil for fees)
4. Verify that underlying transfer is (amount - fee), not more
5. Check for reentrancy protection in the burn-then-transfer flow
6. Verify Unwrapped event is emitted with correct parameters

executable_checks.assertion: No reentrancy vulnerabilities in unwrap() function
Unwrap with insufficient zERC20 balance must revert
Fee calculation must use ceiling rounding

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-083-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary where untrusted user submits unwrap request to trusted LiquidityManager.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 correctly enforces burn-before-transfer to protect the boundary
detection_procedure: 1. Verify burn is called before underlying transfer
2. Check that burn amount exactly matches unwrap amount
3. Verify no state changes can occur between burn and transfer
4. Check for reentrancy vectors in the burn operation

executable_checks.assertion: No reentrancy between burn and transfer operations

executable_checks.command: Trace execution flow in unwrap() function
executable_checks.assertion: burn() must be called before underlying.transfer()

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-083-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP -> Action ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20. This check verifies the critical ordering: burn must precede transfer to prevent reentrancy double-spend.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING: Validate correct transfer amount after fee deduction
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the underlying transfer in unwrap() function
2. Verify transferred amount is exactly (unwrap amount - calculated fee)
3. Verify recipient is msg.sender or specified valid recipient
4. Check that fee surplus is correctly tracked
5. Verify transfer uses safe transfer pattern

executable_checks.assertion: Underlying transfer must equal (amount - fee)
Fee surplus must be correctly updated
No unchecked ERC20 transfers in unwrap()

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-089-EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING -> Edge EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary where trusted LiquidityManager sends underlying tokens to untrusted user.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER: Validate value constraint and hash chain update
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the zERC20 contract's _afterTokenTransfer hook
2. Verify value constraint check (value <= 2^248-1) is enforced
3. Check that hash chain is updated atomically with transfer
4. Verify IndexedTransfer event is emitted with monotonic index
5. Check that the hook cannot be bypassed

executable_checks.assertion: Transfer with value > 2^248-1 must revert with ValueTooLarge
Hash chain must be updated on every transfer
IndexedTransfer event index must be strictly monotonic
Hook must be called for all transfer paths (transfer, transferFrom, mint, burn)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-090-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary where untrusted user initiates zERC20 transfer to trusted contract.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE correctly enforces BN254 field constraint
detection_procedure: 1. Verify MAX_VALUE constant is correctly set to 2^248-1
2. Check the comparison uses <= not < for the constraint
3. Verify the check cannot be bypassed via overflow
4. Check that the error message is correct (ValueTooLarge)

executable_checks.assertion: MAX_VALUE must equal 2^248-1
Constraint check must be: value <= MAX_VALUE

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-090-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER -> Action ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE. This check verifies the BN254 scalar field constraint enforcement.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN correctly extends the hash chain
detection_procedure: 1. Verify hash chain update uses SHA-256
2. Check that (to, value) is correctly encoded in the hash input
3. Verify the hash is truncated to 248 bits correctly
4. Check that the hash chain is stored atomically with balance update
5. Verify the hash chain cannot be manipulated by external callers

executable_checks.assertion: Same transfers must produce same hash chain state
Hash chain value must be <= 2^248-1
Hash input must be keccak256(abi.encodePacked(previousHash, to, value)) or similar

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-090-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER -> Action ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN. This check verifies the hash chain extension is correct and deterministic.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED: Validate event emission and data integrity
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IndexedTransfer event definition and emission
2. Verify event contains: index, from, to, value, hashChain
3. Check that index is monotonically increasing
4. Verify event is emitted atomically with state changes
5. Check that event cannot be emitted without actual transfer

executable_checks.assertion: IndexedTransfer event must contain correct transfer data
Event index must match internal counter exactly
Event must be emitted for all transfer types

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-098-EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED -> Edge EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED. This check verifies the trust boundary where trusted zERC20 sends events to semi-trusted Indexer.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT: Validate hash chain source authenticity
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the reserveHashChain() or equivalent function in Verifier
2. Verify that hashChain is READ from the zERC20 contract, not from user input
3. Check that the zERC20 address is a trusted immutable/constant
4. Verify the checkpoint is stored correctly with unique index
5. Check that HashChainReserved event is emitted

executable_checks.assertion: Hash chain must be read from zERC20, not from calldata
zERC20 address must be immutable or constant
Must call zERC20.hashChain() or equivalent trusted source

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-101-EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT. This check verifies the trust boundary where untrusted caller triggers checkpoint reservation using only trusted data sources.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED: Validate cryptographic proof verification
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the proveTransferRoot() or equivalent function
2. Verify IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() is called
3. Check that the reserved checkpoint is used as public input
4. Verify the proof verification result is checked (must revert on failure)
5. Check that divergent proof detection is implemented
6. Verify only successfully verified roots are stored

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid Nova proof must cause revert
Proof submission must require existing reserved checkpoint
Conflicting proofs for same index must trigger emergency
Proof must be verified before any state changes

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-104-EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED -> Edge EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED. This check verifies the CRITICAL trust boundary where untrusted user submits Nova proof to trusted Verifier for cryptographic verification.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF correctly verifies Groth16 proofs
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the IRootDecider interface and implementation
2. Verify Groth16 pairing check is correctly implemented
3. Check that verification key is correct and immutable
4. Verify public inputs are correctly extracted and bound
5. Check gas limits for proof verification DoS resistance

executable_checks.assertion: Known valid proof must verify successfully
Modified proof elements must fail verification
Proof verification must complete within reasonable gas

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-104-EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF. This check verifies the cryptographic core of proof verification.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT: Validate only proved roots are relayed
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the relayRoot() or equivalent function
2. Verify that root relay only occurs from STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED
3. Check that the relayed root matches the stored proved root
4. Verify LayerZero message is correctly formatted
5. Check that the source EID will be validated on Hub side

executable_checks.assertion: Root relay must only occur after successful proof verification
Relayed root must match the stored proved root

executable_checks.command: Review state machine transitions for relay
executable_checks.assertion: No path to relay without prior proof verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-107-EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT. This check verifies the trust boundary where trusted Verifier sends proved root to semi-trusted LayerZero.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT: Validate EID source authentication
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Hub contract's _lzReceive() function
2. Verify source EID is validated against registered Verifier list
3. Check that unknown EIDs cause message rejection
4. Verify the peer registry is correctly maintained
5. Check that EID validation cannot be bypassed

executable_checks.assertion: Messages from unregistered EIDs must be rejected
Messages from registered Verifier EIDs must be accepted
EID validation must not have zero-check bypass
EID check must be first operation before any payload processing

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-109-EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT -> Edge EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT. This check verifies the CRITICAL trust boundary where semi-trusted LayerZero delivers to trusted Hub with mandatory EID validation.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT correctly validates source before storing
detection_procedure: 1. Verify EID validation occurs before any storage writes
2. Check that the root is stored only for valid tokens
3. Verify token index mapping is correctly maintained
4. Check for race conditions in root updates

executable_checks.assertion: No storage changes must occur for invalid EID
EID validation must precede all storage operations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-109-EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT -> Action ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT. This check verifies that source validation is the first step before any state changes.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT: Validate complete broadcast to all Verifiers
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Hub contract's broadcast() function
2. Verify all registered Verifier endpoints receive the message
3. Check that aggregation root is correctly computed before broadcast
4. Verify aggSeq is incremented monotonically
5. Check for partial failure handling

executable_checks.assertion: Broadcast must send to all registered endpoints
aggSeq must increment on each broadcast
Broadcast root must match computed PoseidonT3 tree

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-116-EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT -> Edge EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT. This check verifies the trust boundary where trusted Hub broadcasts to semi-trusted LayerZero multicast.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL: Validate Hub EID authentication
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Verifier contract's _lzReceive() function
2. Verify source EID is validated against hubEid
3. Check that non-Hub messages are rejected
4. Verify global root is stored only after EID validation
5. Check GlobalRootReceived event is emitted

executable_checks.assertion: Global root from non-Hub EID must be rejected
Global root from authorized Hub EID must be accepted
EID must match stored hubEid exactly

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-117-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL. This check verifies the CRITICAL trust boundary where semi-trusted LayerZero delivers global root to trusted Verifier.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT correctly stores validated global root
detection_procedure: 1. Verify global root storage occurs only after Hub EID validation
2. Check that globalTransferRoots mapping is correctly indexed
3. Verify sequence number handling for ordering
4. Check for race conditions in global root updates

executable_checks.assertion: Global root storage must require prior Hub EID validation
Global root must be stored at correct sequence index

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-117-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT. This check verifies validated global root storage.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER: Validate zero-knowledge property preservation
detection_procedure: 1. Review the IVC proof submission format
2. Verify only public inputs and cryptographic commitments are transmitted
3. Check that private witness data (secrets) is NOT included
4. Verify the proof serialization doesn't leak private information
5. Check transport security (HTTPS/TLS)

executable_checks.command: Review IVC proof structure in CLI client
executable_checks.assertion: Proof must contain only: public inputs, cryptographic commitments, proof elements

executable_checks.command: Review API endpoint for proof submission
executable_checks.assertion: No private witness data in request payload

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-122-EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER -> Edge EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER. This check verifies the trust boundary where untrusted user submits IVC to semi-trusted Prover while preserving zero-knowledge.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC: Validate IVC format and prevent DoS
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the Prover service's IVC reception handler
2. Verify IVC proof format is validated before processing
3. Check that malformed proofs are rejected early
4. Verify resource limits to prevent DoS via malicious proofs
5. Check that local IVC verification is performed before Groth16 conversion

executable_checks.assertion: Malformed IVC must be rejected before heavy computation

executable_checks.command: Review Prover rate limiting and resource caps
executable_checks.assertion: Service must have protection against DoS

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-123-EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC -> Edge EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC. This check verifies the trust boundary where untrusted user submits proof to semi-trusted Prover service.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16: Validate proof retrieval authorization
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the Prover service's proof retrieval endpoint
2. Verify users can only retrieve their own proofs (keyed by job ID)
3. Check that proof data is transmitted securely
4. Verify on-chain verification will catch any proof mismatch

executable_checks.command: Review Prover service proof retrieval authorization
executable_checks.assertion: Job ID must be unpredictable and tied to submission
User A cannot retrieve User B's proof

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-129-EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16 -> Edge EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16. This check verifies the trust boundary where semi-trusted Prover sends proof to untrusted user.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT: Validate front-running protection via recipient binding
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the teleport() function in Verifier contract
2. Verify recipient is bound in the proof's public inputs
3. Check that recipient hash is computed and compared on-chain
4. Verify msg.sender is used as recipient (not user-provided)
5. Check that front-runner cannot claim funds

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport must use msg.sender as recipient and verify against proof
Front-runner cannot claim funds with victim's proof
Hash of msg.sender must match proof public input

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-130-EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT -> Edge EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT. This check verifies the CRITICAL trust boundary where untrusted user submits teleport with front-running protection.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH correctly binds recipient
detection_procedure: 1. Verify recipient hash is computed from msg.sender
2. Check the hash function matches what's used in the circuit
3. Verify comparison with proof public input is strict equality
4. Check that mismatch causes immediate revert

executable_checks.assertion: Recipient hash mismatch must cause revert
Hash function must match circuit implementation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-130-EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH. This check verifies recipient binding prevents fund redirection.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT: Validate complete validation chain
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the teleport() or withdrawLocal/withdrawGlobal functions
2. Verify all four validations are performed in order: root reference, recipient hash, monotonicity, proof
3. Check that no shortcut path exists to minting
4. Verify each validation failure causes appropriate revert
5. Check that teleport() is only called after all validations pass

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport must pass all four validation steps
Validations must occur in correct order
No path to teleport() that bypasses validations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-131-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT. This check verifies the trust boundary where untrusted user submits teleport request for full validation chain.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE correctly checks root existence
detection_procedure: 1. Verify root lookup in provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots
2. Check that non-existent root causes revert
3. Verify the lookup key is correct (not user-controllable beyond expected)
4. Check for zero-value edge cases in mapping lookups

executable_checks.assertion: Non-existent root reference must cause revert
Valid local root must pass validation
Valid global root must pass validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-131-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE. This check verifies root existence validation.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY correctly prevents double-spend
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the totalTeleported tracking mechanism
2. Verify strict inequality check (new > stored, not >=)
3. Check that totalTeleported is updated atomically with mint
4. Verify replay attempts are detected and rejected
5. Check for overflow scenarios in totalTeleported

executable_checks.assertion: Replay of same proof must be rejected
New totalTeleported must be strictly greater than stored
Proof with lower totalTeleported must be rejected
Comparison must be: newTotalTeleported > storedTotalTeleported

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-131-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY. This check verifies the CRITICAL double-spend prevention mechanism.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF correctly verifies Groth16 proofs
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the withdrawal proof verification code
2. Verify correct decider is selected (local vs global)
3. Check that Groth16 pairing check is correctly implemented
4. Verify public inputs are correctly extracted from proof
5. Check that verification failure causes revert

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid withdrawal proof must cause revert
Valid withdrawal proof must pass verification
Correct decider must be selected based on proof type

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-131-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF. This check verifies the cryptographic core of withdrawal proof verification.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT correctly mints after all validations
detection_procedure: 1. Verify teleport() is only callable after all validations pass
2. Check that minted amount matches proof's delta
3. Verify recipient is the verified address
4. Check that totalTeleported is updated correctly
5. Verify Teleported event is emitted

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport must mint exact delta from proof
totalTeleported must be updated after teleport
Teleported event must be emitted

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-131-EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT. This check verifies the final minting step after all validations.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE: Validate balance check before bridge
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the Adaptor contract's unwrapAndBridge() function
2. Verify user's zERC20 balance is checked before proceeding
3. Check that unwrap is called before bridge
4. Verify bridge parameters are validated

executable_checks.assertion: Bridge with insufficient zERC20 balance must revert
Unwrap must complete before bridge call

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-142-EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE -> Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE. This check verifies the trust boundary for cross-chain exit initiation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ADAPTOR-RECEIVES-REQUEST: Validate bridge parameters
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the bridge parameter validation in Adaptor
2. Verify destination chain ID is valid
3. Check that slippage limits are validated
4. Verify refund address handling
5. Check for invalid destination address handling

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid destination chain must cause revert
Slippage parameters must be validated
Refund address must be handled correctly

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-143-EDGE-ADAPTOR-RECEIVES-REQUEST -> Edge EDGE-ADAPTOR-RECEIVES-REQUEST. This check verifies the trust boundary for bridge request parameter validation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES: Validate slippage protection via minAmountOut
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the Stargate.send() call in Adaptor
2. Verify minAmountOut parameter is correctly set
3. Check that slippage exceeding limit causes revert
4. Verify user-specified slippage tolerance is respected
5. Check for sandwich attack protection

executable_checks.assertion: minAmountOut must enforce user's slippage tolerance
Excessive slippage must cause Stargate revert
minAmountOut must be user-configurable or calculated

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-145-EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES -> Edge EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES. This check verifies the trust boundary where trusted Adaptor sends to semi-trusted Stargate with slippage protection.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE correctly handles bridge failures
detection_procedure: 1. Locate error handling for Stargate.send() failures
2. Verify funds are not stuck in Adaptor on failure
3. Check that refund mechanism works correctly
4. Verify user is not left without zERC20 or underlying

executable_checks.assertion: Bridge failure must trigger refund mechanism
User must not lose funds on bridge failure
Failure after unwrap must not leave user empty-handed

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-145-EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES -> Action ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE. This check verifies error handling for the external bridge dependency.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-EMERGENCY-ROTATE-VERIFIERS: Validate owner-only access
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the setVerifiers() or equivalent function
2. Verify onlyOwner modifier is applied
3. Check that there's no way to bypass owner check
4. Verify owner address is correctly initialized and immutable
5. Check for emergency-specific verifier rotation logic

executable_checks.assertion: Non-owner must not be able to set verifiers
No access control vulnerabilities in admin functions
Owner must be able to set new verifiers

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-148-EDGE-EMERGENCY-ROTATE-VERIFIERS -> Edge EDGE-EMERGENCY-ROTATE-VERIFIERS. This check verifies the trust boundary for admin verifier rotation during emergency.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY: Validate owner-only deactivation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the deactivateEmergency() or equivalent function
2. Verify onlyOwner modifier is applied
3. Check that emergency state is correctly cleared
4. Verify the function can only be called during emergency state
5. Check for any prerequisites before deactivation

executable_checks.assertion: Non-owner must not be able to deactivate emergency
Deactivation must clear emergency flag
Normal operations must resume after deactivation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-149-EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY -> Edge EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY. This check verifies the trust boundary for admin emergency deactivation.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY correctly restores normal operation
detection_procedure: 1. Verify all emergency-specific state is cleared
2. Check that normal protocol functions are re-enabled
3. Verify event is emitted for transparency
4. Check for any lingering emergency-mode effects

executable_checks.assertion: All emergency state must be cleared
EmergencyDeactivated event must be emitted

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-149-EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY -> Action ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY. This check verifies complete state restoration after emergency.

checklist.title: Comprehensive LayerZero EID Validation: Verify all cross-chain message endpoints validate source EID
detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all contracts that receive LayerZero messages (_lzReceive)
2. For each contract, verify source EID validation is first check
3. Verify Hub validates against Verifier EID list
4. Verify Verifier validates against Hub EID
5. Check that there's no way to bypass EID checks
6. Verify EID storage cannot be manipulated

executable_checks.assertion: No unchecked low-level calls that bypass validation
